parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the pot, made of ceramic material. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the container to cover its opening.
parts.Functional_description: The lid serves to cover the pot, preventing dust or contaminants from entering and helping to retain heat or moisture inside.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted off or placed onto the container; it does not have any mechanical movement other than manual placement.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pot, made of ceramic material. It has a rounded shape with a narrow neck and a wide base for stability.
parts.Functional_description: The container holds liquids or solids, serving as the primary storage volume of the pot.
parts.Movement_description: The container itself is stationary and does not move; it supports the lid and holds the contents securely.
